claims.claim: Spoken / sighted in lat. 43 N, long. 44 W (May 25)
claims.verbatim:
The Persia at this port, from Liverpool, reports having passed vessels
as follows: May 20, off Tuskar, Company's steamship Africa, bound
to Liverpool; May 20, off Queenstown, British bark Eddystone; May
25, in lat. 43 N, long. 44 W, Br. bark "Maxwell," bound W; May 27,
in lat. 42 N, long. 60 W, Am. steamship Ericsson, bound E; May 28,
in lat. 41, long. 60, Bremen ship Charlotte, bound W.
